podcast.title: Early Bandmate with Ian Thornley
podcast.body: Kurt Schaffer was a guitarist in an early pop band with a 13-year-old Ian Thornley. Schaffer was 21 at the time and was the next youngest member of the band. He later gained recognition for playing with Alannah Myles, including on her hit "Black Velvet." "I was in a band with Kurt Schafter. He was the next young guy."
